File No. B. 10-G1
S.I, Special Branch
REPORT
Date. JUNE 6th. 1935.
Subject. Yellow River Flood Relief Lottery.
Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by H. Gruff C.S.I.

The Yellow River Flood Relief Lottery has ceased
functioning following the 12th Drawing which took place on
ay 15 in Tientsin. The discontinuation of this lottery
was ordered by the National Government on or about ay 15
despite repeated requests made by the Hopei Provincial
Authorities for permission to maintain it.

Sih Tse Liang
D. I.

D. C. (Special Branch)

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
File No. D
S.I, Special Branch
REPORT
Date. March 18, 1935.

Subject Yellow River Flood Relief Lottery.

Made by D.S.I. Duncan Forwarded by H. Gruff O!

The Yellow River Flood Relief Lottery was established in June, 1934, by the Hopei Provincial Government for the purpose of raising funds for the relief of victims of the Yellow River floods.

Tickets are sold at $1 each and may be purchased at almost any shop in the Settlement where National State Lottery tickets are on sale.

The lottery is comprised of 200,000 numbers and of the sum thus raised $100,000 is given in prizes as follows :-

| | |
| :--- | :--- |
| 1st Prize | $40,000. |
| 2nd " | two of $10,000 each. |
| 3rd " | three of $4,000 each. |
| 4th " | 200 of $ 120 each. |
| 5th " | 2,000 of $ 2 each. |

The drawings take place on the 15th of each month at the head office in Tientsin.

The local office of the Lottery was formerly located at room 410, No.263 Min Kuo Road, but at the end of February, 1935, the Manager, Wong Tsz-mei (王子梅), absconded with a sum of $10,000. Since then the Agricultural and Industrial Bank of China, 348 Honan Road, has acted as financial managers and prize issuing agency.

It is reported that the National Government is contemplating withdrawing the permit granted for this lottery after the 12th drawing which falls due on May 15 on the grounds that it impairs the sale of the State Lottery tickets.

The S.M.C. has not approved the sale of these

S.I，特务科
报告
日期：1935年3月18日。

主题：黄河水灾救济彩票。

由副督察长邓肯（Duncan）呈报，经 H. Gruff O! 转呈。

黄河水灾救济彩票由河北省政府于1934年6月设立，旨在为黄河水灾灾民筹集救济资金。

彩票每张售价1元，可在租界内几乎所有销售“国家彩票”的商店购买。

该彩票共设20万个号码，所筹款项中10万元作为奖金发放，具体如下：

| | |
| :--- | :--- |
| 头奖 | 40,000元。 |
| 二等奖 | 两名，各10,000元。 |
| 三等奖 | 三名，各4,000元。 |
| 四等奖 | 200名，各120元。 |
| 五等奖 | 2,000名，各2元。 |

每月15日在天津总部进行开奖。

该彩票本地办事处原位于民国路263号410室，但1935年2月底，经理王子梅（Wong Tsz-mei）携款10,000元潜逃。此后，河南路348号的中国农工银行担任财务经理及兑奖机构。

据报，国民政府正考虑在第12次开奖（定于5月15日）后撤销对该彩票的许可，理由是其影响了国家彩票的销售。

Louza Station,
REPORT
Date Mar. 14, 19 35.
Subject Addendum to Report Re Sale of Sweepstake Tickets in the
Settlement (dated 14-3-35).
Made by Inspector Mac Farlane Forwarded by
Sir,
In keeping observation re lottery shops selling lottery
tickets other than the "National Government Lottery"
in Louza District, whilst patrolling Nanking Road at about
7.30 p.m. 14-3-35, I saw lottery tickets of "Yellow River
Flood Relief Lottery" being sold publicly at the Zoo Lee Zoo
Lottery shop, 530 Nanking Road. I thereupon purchased the
attached ticket No. 185260 for $1.00.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. McFarlane.
Inspector.
